_comment: The first-run wizard's curated chat models (adr/0013), read by LLMTrayCore.ModelRecommendations. tiers: the memory tiers (GB of RAM: 8, 16, 24, 32 = 32 and up) an entry is offered in; minMemoryGB: never offered below it; recommended: marked and listed first (one per tier). approxBytes: the repo's current files (HF API, ?blobs=true), used until the Hub's live size is read. Every repo here was checked to exist, be ungated and load with the pinned mlx-lm's model code (2026-09-26).

models.title: Gemma 4 26B-A4B (GPTQ)
models.summary: Google's mixture-of-experts Gemma 4 with 4B active parameters, quantized with GPTQ by LLMTray's authors; reads images and calls tools.

models.title: Gemma 4 E4B (GPTQ)
models.summary: A small Gemma 4, quantized with GPTQ by LLMTray's authors, that leaves room for other apps on a 16 GB Mac; reads images and calls tools.

models.title: Gemma 4 E2B (4-bit)
models.summary: The smallest Gemma 4, for everyday questions and short texts on an 8 GB Mac; reads images and calls tools.

models.title: Nemotron 3 Nano 4B, coding agent
models.summary: NVIDIA's small Nemotron, fine-tuned by LLMTray's authors for tool calling in a terminal coding agent; text only.

models.title: Mistral Small 3.2 24B (4-bit)
models.summary: Mistral's dense 24B model, slower than a mixture-of-experts model of its size, good at following instructions in many languages; text only.

models.title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B, coding agent
models.summary: NVIDIA's mixture-of-experts Nemotron, fine-tuned by LLMTray's authors for tool calling in a terminal coding agent; text only.

models.title: Gemma 4 31B (4-bit)
models.summary: The largest Gemma 4, a dense model: slower than 26B-A4B, stronger on hard questions; reads images and calls tools.
